objectives.objective: Select and contract a new CRM vendor for our 40-person sales team within three weeks.
objectives.context: Three vendor proposals are attached. Must support Arabic, WhatsApp integration and data hosting in Saudi Arabia. Budget ceiling: 180,000 SAR per year.

perturbations.message: Client: the CRM must also integrate with our ERP. Please account for that.

objectives.objective: Review the logistics agreement from Al-Noor Logistics against our procurement policy and get it ready for signature by Thursday.
objectives.context: Agreement excerpt: payment due 15 days after invoice; supplier liability capped at 10% of annual fees; auto-renews for 3 years unless cancelled 180 days before expiry; disputes under London courts. Policy excerpt: payment terms at least 45 days; liability cap at least 100% of annual fees; auto-renewal no longer than 1 year with 60 days notice; governing law Saudi Arabia.

objectives.objective: أطلق مركز دعم العملاء باللغتين العربية والإنجليزية قبل نهاية الشهر لمتجرنا الإلكتروني للعطور.
objectives.context: المتجر يستقبل نحو 300 استفسار يومياً، أكثرها عن الشحن والاسترجاع وأصالة المنتجات. يستخدم الفريق منصة Zendesk.

perturbations.message: العميل: نحتاج أيضاً ردوداً جاهزة لواتساب بنفس الموعد.

objectives.objective: Move our Jeddah office of 35 staff to the new building on Tahlia Street by December 15 with no more than one day of downtime.
objectives.context: The floor plan of the new office is attached. Servers and the network must move over one weekend. Moving budget: 60,000 SAR.

perturbations.message: Client: the archive room also moves, about 40 boxes of paper files.

objectives.objective: ابدأ حملة تواصل مع عشرين شركة لوجستية في المنطقة الشرقية لحجز عشرة اجتماعات تعريفية خلال أسبوعين.
objectives.context: نبيع نظام تتبع شحنات. تقرير السوق المرفق يضم قائمة بأربعين شركة لوجستية. الخصم الأقصى المسموح للعملاء الجدد 15٪ بموافقة المدير.
